elements.text:
Answer as many questions as
you can!

What is the largest
planet in the solar
system?

How many legs does a
spider have?

What is the largest
ocean on Earth?

What is the chemical
symbol for gold?

How many bones are
in an adult human
body?

What is the capital of
Australia?

What is the fastest
land animal?

How many minutes
are there in a day?

In which year did
humans first walk on
the Moon?
